mappings.basis: Operational decomposition of the dated ACP alternatives for service review. These components are not a complete clinical protocol or evidence of buyer capability.

components.label: Qualified CBT delivery and follow-up
checks: Verify actual CBT intervention, clinician qualifications, format, schedule and follow-up.
Confirm patient preference, ability to participate and exact psychotherapy benefits.

components.label: Prescribing assessment and medication monitoring
checks: Verify an appropriately qualified prescribing clinician, medication review and monitoring arrangements.
Confirm exact medication access, formulary/authorization, follow-up and patient consent; no drug or dose is chosen here.
